documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Approval Of Financial Results For The Period Ended On 30Th September 2026
Financial Results For The Period Ended On 30Th September, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Financial Result For Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Management reported that Mazda currently holds an order book of approximately ₹115 to ₹116 crores across various verticals, though performance in the first two quarters was impacted by client delays in lifting ready products and boiler maintenance. Despite intense competition in the engineering market, management expects full-year results for FY 2024-25 to match or exceed those of FY 2023-24. The company is actively driving growth and diversification through new product developments such as Smart Rod Systems, Ion Exchange Membranes, advanced evaporation systems, and chemical-free cleaning solutions. Meanwhile, the foods division is targeting an average of 15% to 20% year-on-year growth and building towards a turnover of ₹60 crore within three years. Mazda Limited management reported a positive performance for the engineering division, driven by order execution from refineries and petrochemical projects, while noting increased competition and pricing pressure.

guidance.claim: Management expects that for the financial year 2024-25, the company will be able to match, if not exceed, the results of the preceding year 2023-24.
guidance.quote: However, we expect that for the financial year 2024-25, we will be able to match, if not exceed, the results of the preceding year 2023-24.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve an annual turnover of ₹60 crore for the food division within three years.
guidance.quote: With everything in place, we aim to achieve annual turnover of ₹ 60 Crore within three years, which would be the full capacity.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top-line growth of approximately 15% for the fiscal year 2023-24.
guidance.quote: What is the outlook for year 23-24 in terms of top line and bottom line? So, the top line is expected to see a growth of around 15% compared to last year when the bottom line will also be more or less in line with that.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes a slowdown in the speed of inquiries and project development.
demand_outlook.quote: But I am not very sure about the future because there is a certain degree of slowness or return in the speed of the inquiries or in the speed of the projects that are coming up.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects sustained demand for engineering products due to ongoing infrastructure and industrial investments.
demand_outlook.quote: Continued investments in infrastructure, industrial automation, digital manufacturing, clean energy, and capacity expansion across manufacturing industries are expected to generate sustained demand for engineering products and services.

demand_outlook.claim: The food processing sector is projected to maintain healthy double-digit growth over the medium term.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry estimates indicate that the food processing sector is expected to maintain healthy double-digit growth over the medium term, supported by favourable demographics and sustained investments in processing infrastructure and supply chains.

capex_expansion.claim: The company does not plan further capital expenditure for the engineering division for the next 2-3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we do not envisage going in for expansion Capex at least as far as the Engineering division is concerned for the next 2-3 years, because we can really scale up to, we did a thorough study and we think that we can do a dispatch of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively working to expand its food business distribution network in Gujarat and Delhi/NCR.
capex_expansion.quote: We have grown our distribution teams in both Delhi/NCR and Gujarat and we are keen to expand our domestic outreach in partnership with our consultants.

margins_costs.claim: Evaporators are used for recovering water from industrial effluent, resulting in lower profitability compared to vacuum systems.
margins_costs.quote: While there is notable growth in the evaporator division, it's important to note that evaporators are used for recovering water from industrial effluent (waste water), which results in lower profitability compared to vacuum systems.

margins_costs.claim: Margins are under pressure due to intense competition and a price war in the industry.
margins_costs.quote: Competition is becoming very intense. It is almost like a price war going on. Margins are under pressure always and we have to really fight it out, slug it out to get us one order.

margins_costs.claim: The Food Division achieved a 34% profit increase through operational efficiencies and cost management.
margins_costs.quote: The Food Division reported a 2.84% slight decline in turnover compared to the previous financial year. However, despite the marginal decline in revenue, the division achieved a 34.00% increase in profit, driven by improved operational efficiencies, effective cost management, and a favourable product mix.

orders_capacity.claim: The total orders on hand amount to approximately ₹115 to ₹116 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: In total, we currently have around ₹115 to ₹116 crores in orders on hand.

orders_capacity.claim: American partner Croll-Reynolds has placed orders totaling ₹7 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Our American partner, Croll-Reynolds, has placed orders totalling ₹ 7 crore with us.

orders_capacity.claim: The engineering division has an installed capacity to cater to 250 crores of revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the food division that was consuming the space is now available to the Engineering division and therefore the total area that we have now, we can cater to around 250 crores only for the Engineering division.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book is sufficient for one year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: And as far as the order book is concerned, we don't share the numbers as such, but it is considerably good to make us from there, we will not like to share the numbers but as far as the current year order book is concerned, it is safe enough for one year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a stable capital structure with virtually no long-term debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Mazda has maintained its stable capital structure with virtually zero long-term borrowings as of 31st March, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified geopolitical tensions, volatile input costs, and supply chain disruptions as key risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the positive outlook, the company remains mindful of risks arising from global economic uncertainty, changes in regulatory and policy frameworks, volatility in raw material prices, foreign exchange fluctuations and potential supply chain disruptions.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Engineering Division's performance is sensitive to industrial capital expenditure cycles.
risks_headwinds.quote: This division remains highly dependent on industrial capital expenditure (capex) macro cycles.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch the ion exchange membrane product in about a year.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch this product in about a year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to launch high gravity-based equipment in 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to launch it in 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to grow into a 500 crore company.
management_commitments.quote: Mr. Agrawal, everyone likes to grow. So, our ultimate aim is to grow and make it a 500 crore companies.

management_commitments.claim: The company will not undertake engineering division capex for the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we do not envisage going in for expansion Capex at least as far as the Engineering division is concerned for the next 2-3 years

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase its distributor network in Gujarat to 40 distributors.
management_commitments.quote: In Gujarat, our distribution network comprises 26 distributors, and we aim to increase this to 40 distributors over the next couple of months.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its Delhi/NCR distributor network to 10.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have a network of 6 distributors across the Delhi/NCR region, with plans to expand this to 10 distributors.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
